sub_sector.value: Coca-Cola bottling and nonalcoholic beverage distribution

product_category.detail: Sparkling and still nonalcoholic beverages: Coca-Cola brands, energy, water, tea, coffee, juices, sports drinks.

market_position.detail: Mainstream national Coca-Cola and partner brands sold broadly across many states.

distribution_model.detail: Makes, packages and delivers beverages directly to stores, restaurants, venues and offices via distribution and sales centers.

purchase_frequency.detail: Everyday refreshment beverages bought repeatedly through stores, restaurants and venues.

notes: Market position and purchase frequency inferred from the nature of mainstream soft drink brands.
